install_dir.description: Installation directory for Eureka assets (game definitions, key bindings, etc.).

home_dir.description: User home directory for config, backups, logs.

log_file.description: Path (relative or absolute) to the log file.

config_file.description: Path (relative or absolute) to the config file.

wad_files.description: List of WAD files to edit. If empty, the first map in the IWAD is opened.

map_name.description: Map to edit (e.g., MAP01, E1M1, 01, 1 1). If empty, defaults to first map in WAD.

iwad_file.description: Name of the IWAD file. Determines the target game (Doom, Heretic, etc.).

resource_files.description: List of resource WADs and/or .ugh definition files to merge.

port_name.description: Target port/engine name (e.g., boom, vanilla, odamex, edge, legacy).
